metadata.question: Did the surface water area of Poyang Lake in China’s Jiangxi Province decrease between July 10, 2022 and August 27, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use JRC Global Surface Water dataset, specifically the 'occurrence' band (water classification in % of time water was present). Filter two single-date composites centered on July 10 2022 and Aug 27 2022. 2. Masking: Use JRC’s built-in quality/valid mask; also clip to the lake boundary plus a generous buffer to reduce land-pixel noise. 3. Logic: Compute total water pixels (occurrence ≥ 50 %) for each date. If counts decrease → “Yes”. Handle C1/C2 by checking collection size and valid-pixel counts after clipping. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Pts lake = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([115.7, 28.9, 117.0, 29.8]) # Poyang Lake d1 = ee.Date('2022-07-10') d2 = ee.Date('2022-08-27') # 2. Acquire JRC Water col = ee.ImageCollection("JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory") i1 = col.filterBounds(lake).filter(ee.Filter.date(d1, d1.advance(1, 'month'))).first() i2 = col.filterBounds(lake).filter(ee.Filter.date(d2, d2.advance(1, 'month'))).first() if i1 is None or i2 is None: print("C1") print("C1") exit() # 3. Binary water mask (water class == 2) w1 = i1.select('water').eq(2).rename('w') w2 = i2.select('water').eq(2).rename('w') # 4. Count water pixels scale = 1000 c1 = w1.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=lake, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('w').getInfo() c2 = w2.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=lake, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('w').getInfo() print(f"Jul 2022 pixels: {int(c1)}") print(f"Aug 2022 pixels: {int(c2)}") if c1 is None or c2 is None: print("C3") elif c1 == 0 or c2 == 0: print("C2") else: print("A" if c2 < c1 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Pts
lake = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([115.7, 28.9, 117.0, 29.8])  # Poyang Lake
d1 = ee.Date('2022-07-10')
d2 = ee.Date('2022-08-27')

# 2. Acquire JRC Water
col = ee.ImageCollection("JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory")
i1 = col.filterBounds(lake).filter(ee.Filter.date(d1, d1.advance(1, 'month'))).first()
i2 = col.filterBounds(lake).filter(ee.Filter.date(d2, d2.advance(1, 'month'))).first()

if i1 is None or i2 is None:
    print("C1")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Binary water mask (water class == 2)
w1 = i1.select('water').eq(2).rename('w')
w2 = i2.select('water').eq(2).rename('w')

# 4. Count water pixels
scale = 1000
c1 = w1.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=lake, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('w').getInfo()
c2 = w2.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=lake, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('w').getInfo()

print(f"Jul 2022 pixels: {int(c1)}")
print(f"Aug 2022 pixels: {int(c2)}")

if c1 is None or c2 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif c1 == 0 or c2 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if c2 < c1 else "<answer>B</answer>")
